note: Every id is the audit's own. A finding closes in this file (status, with a dated receipt) when its fix lands; CO-215 closes when no carriedBy CO-215 entry is open, CO-216 likewise. Not re-measured against the 0.3.4 tree: some may already be fixed, and the wave that takes one re-reads it first.

findings.title: A failed `projects.list` is an unhandled rejection.
findings.proposedFix: Catch in `refreshProjects` and keep a `projectsFailed` reason beside the last list. EstateHome then renders a Banner with the reason and a Retry that calls `refreshProjects`, and keeps the previous list visible as stale.

findings.title: A grant is journalled before its row exists, and main does not validate the floor class the renderer sends.
findings.proposedFix: Validate `floorClass` against the three classes in the `attentionGrant` handler before any append, and do not offer "Allow once" for an `unknown` class. Make the grant row a projection of `grant.issued@1`, or write both in one RPC transaction.

findings.title: Promoting a task note checks first and appends later, with no lock, and the button has no in-flight guard.
findings.proposedFix: Move promotion into one RPC that locks the `task_notes` row and appends both events in one transaction, like `decide_proposal`. Disable the button while the call is in flight.

findings.title: A paused routine says "due as soon as Fabric looks".
findings.proposedFix: Render an explicit "paused" line when `!r.enabled`, and format `dueAt` with `toLocaleString(locale)`, as ReleasesScreen does.

findings.title: Pause/Resume of a routine fails silently.
findings.proposedFix: Add `.catch((e) => onError(String(e)))`. In main, refuse when `error` or `!data`, and validate that `enabled` is a boolean.

findings.title: The scenario's "notification deep link" entry does not exist.
findings.proposedFix: Carry the item's `attentionKey`/`EntityRef` in the click handler, send it to the renderer over IPC and route it through `openEntity`.

findings.title: The coverage claim names files and a test that do not implement the scenario.
findings.proposedFix: Set Coverage to "none yet". Add a note that ADR-0115's agent-initiated consent (SCN-132, `AgentAccessPanel.tsx`) is the shipped alternative. Then either amend SCN-022 by ADR or keep it as a target.

findings.title: The screens index and the screen records disagree.
findings.proposedFix: Make records and index agree: `built` (partial) with the same coverage paths, and keep the "Not built" lists.

findings.title: The amendment presents in-Fabric conversion as the current path, and the index marks SCR-75 `built`.
findings.proposedFix: Mark SCR-75 `designed` (placeholder built), and phrase the amendment as target ("will run inside Fabric…").

findings.title: SCR-01's success state promises cards sorted "by attention then operator preference".
findings.proposedFix: Add the attention ordering to the "Not built" list, or rank by `counts[p.id].total` within each group.

findings.title: A missing name shows no inline error.
findings.proposedFix: Show a `field-problem` under Name after a submit attempt with an empty name, or add a hint tied by `aria-describedby` that says why Create is disabled.

findings.title: After a successful create, the draft is never deleted.
findings.proposedFix: In `replaceDraft`, delete `drafts[draftId]`, as `closeTab` does at `src/renderer/src/App.tsx:484-488`.

findings.title: Several home reads fail silently.
findings.proposedFix: Keep a fourth state for the workspace question ("could not read"). Add catches that set `pinProblem`. Pass a real `onError` that shows a banner.

findings.title: An accepted proposal reads "made task 3f2a…", a raw UUID with no link.
findings.proposedFix: Render the task title with an open-task action. Return `reasonCode` only and phrase it in i18n per code.

findings.title: The settings compare-and-set is a read-then-append without a lock.
findings.proposedFix: Do the compare inside a DB function under the estate/project lock, as `decide_proposal` does, and append only if `config_revision = base_revision`.

findings.title: The legacy `projects.update` and `projects.updateSettings` IPC channels are still exposed although no renderer code calls them.
findings.proposedFix: Remove both channels from preload, main and the `IPC` map, or route them through `saveProjectSettings`.

findings.title: The releases list is capped at 200 rows and the envelope carries no omission.
findings.proposedFix: Query per tab with `projectId`, and add an `omitted` entry when `rows.length === bounded`.

findings.title: Repeated controls have identical accessible names: "Pause"/"Resume" on every routine and "Remove" on every repository.
findings.proposedFix: Add `aria-label` with the routine instruction or the repository path, as EstateHome does for pin, up and down (`src/renderer/src/EstateHome.tsx:224`, `:237`).

findings.title: Launch stays enabled when the chosen runner is unavailable.
findings.proposedFix: Disable Launch when `!options.find((o) => o.id === choice)?.available` and say why.

findings.title: Dead branch: `openTask` is always null after the early return, so the in-column `<TaskPage>` and the `!openTask &&` guards never take effect.
findings.proposedFix: Delete the unreachable ternary and the redundant guards.

findings.title: The routines list starts as `[]` and says "Nothing runs on a schedule in this project" before the read returns, which is the M108 claim-before-measure the codebase forbids elsewhere.
findings.proposedFix: Start at `null` and use `<EmptyState read={rows !== null}>`.

findings.title: When the project's MCP grants cannot be read, the error is dropped and the session launches with zero granted servers.
findings.proposedFix: Destructure `error` and throw "the project's MCP grants could not be read: …" so `compile` refuses the launch.

findings.where: SCN-029 errors, SCN-025 step 5 / SCR-03 tile, SCR-25
findings.title: No provider observer is wired, so every non-shell session that ends on its own resolves to `outcome_unknown`/`provider_termination_unproved`.
findings.proposedFix: Show the stop chip only when the operator asked to stop. For a natural exit show ended plus the exit code, and allow dismissing it with a "provider work not proven ended" caveat. Otherwise amend SCN-025 and SCN-029.

findings.title: A project whose repository was moved or deleted still launches.
findings.proposedFix: In `PtyManager.open`, check `statSync(cwd).isDirectory()` before minting anything, throw `SpawnFailure(program, cwd, 'directory does not exist')`, and add a case to `test/pty-launch-failure.test.mjs`.

findings.title: "Revoke all" (danger tone) and each per-grant "Revoke" act on one click with no confirmation, although revocation is irreversible and SCN-024 says "selects Revoke access and confirms".
findings.proposedFix: Add an inline confirm state like `SessionStop`'s, naming what stops and that history stays, before `hub.revokeAgent`. Alternatively reconcile SCN-024 with SCN-132.

findings.title: Coverage cites `agentSurface.ts` and `agent-surface.test.mjs`, which prove only session-credential scope and revocation.
findings.proposedFix: Narrow Coverage to "step 1 + revocation closes the door (session credentials)". Mark steps 2–5 unbuilt (SCR-22) and cross-reference SCR-76.

findings.title: Every start replays the journal from seq 0, 500 events per 2 s tick.
findings.proposedFix: On first load read the newest N (descending, then reversed), then poll forward. Wake readers only once caught up.

findings.title: With an empty journal, `setFeed` is never called, so `feed` stays `null`.
findings.proposedFix: After the first successful replay, call `setFeed(old => old ?? [])` even when zero rows came back.

findings.title: The project journal and the canvas activity filter the estate's last 500 events.
findings.proposedFix: Replay the project's own feed filtered by `project_id`, or show "nothing in the latest 500 estate events" instead of the empty claim.

findings.title: The Grant button has no busy state, no success line and no reload.
findings.proposedFix: Disable while in flight, show the returned `grantId`/`expiresAt`, and reload. In `readAttentionWithSources`, mark refusals that already have a live unconsumed grant for the same class and target.

findings.title: `issueGrant` appends `grant.issued@1` to the append-only journal, then inserts into `grants` in a second write.
findings.proposedFix: Validate `floorClass` in the handler, and project `grant.issued@1` inside the append transaction with a projector function.

findings.title: The Task block appends `task.created@1` before launching and never withdraws it when the launch fails.
findings.proposedFix: Hold a client idempotency key with the draft and reuse it on retry, or retry with `tasks.startExisting(id)`. Put the program and cwd in the `launch_failed_before_spawn` message.

findings.title: Step 3 says `task.started@1` records the run, but the Task block appends `task.created@1`.
findings.proposedFix: Amend SCN-032 to the current event and to where history and Use again live, or restore the rows in `Tasks.tsx`.

findings.title: After a save has landed, the header awaits `onChanged()` in the same `try`.
findings.proposedFix: Put `await onChanged()` in its own try. On failure keep the landed outcome, close the editor, show a stale-read note, and add a test where `onChanged` rejects.

findings.title: The settings compare-and-set is a read in main followed by an append.
findings.proposedFix: Enforce `config_revision = payload.base_revision` inside the append RPC or projector (refuse before insert), or serialise saves per project in main.

findings.title: The error banner's Retry does nothing during a conflict (after a policy refusal or a failed `requestOverwrite`).
findings.proposedFix: Have Retry repeat the last mode (`save(conflict !== null)`), or hide it while a conflict is shown.

findings.where: SCN-034 errors ("a failed write leaves … the file untouched")
findings.title: `writeFileSync` writes in place, so a failure mid-write (disk full, I/O) leaves the file truncated.
findings.proposedFix: Write to a temp file in the same directory, fsync, then `renameSync`, preserving the mode. Map ENOENT to `{ok:false, reason:'missing'}` with a sentence.

findings.title: Binary files open as decoded UTF-8 in an editable Monaco window.
findings.proposedFix: Detect binary (a NUL byte in the first 8 KB, or invalid UTF-8) in `readFile` and return a "binary — open in system editor" refusal, or open it read-only.

findings.title: Memory search appends `memory.retrieved@1` on every 200 ms typing pause and on every filter toggle.
findings.proposedFix: Record only an explicit search (Enter/submit), or once per settled query deduplicated per session and query. Skip toggles that do not change the query.

findings.title: Every reload sets `loading` and then `error`, so a failed refresh drops the last good counts and their age.
findings.proposedFix: Keep the previous `ok` value during reload. On error, show the old counts, their `countsAge` and a "refresh failed" banner.

findings.title: Correcting a fact while the category filter is "All" files the replacement under the default `project` category instead of the corrected fact's category, so a corrected runner lesson leaves the runner view.
findings.proposedFix: When correcting, pass `correcting.category`, or have the handler or projector inherit the superseded fact's category.

findings.title: When the transcript list read fails, "Sessions recorded" shows "Reading…" for the life of the page.
findings.proposedFix: Track it as a `KeyedRead`, as Tasks and Memory do, and render the failure with a retry.

findings.title: Opening two captures quickly lets the earlier response render under the row opened later.
findings.proposedFix: Use a request token or `openIdRef` to drop late responses, and render an explicit "no longer in the store" line for `null`.

findings.title: The lease line uses `since()` on a future `expires_at`.
findings.proposedFix: Use `until(detail.lease.expires_at, t)`, and add a TaskPage test with a future `expires_at`.

findings.title: "Add note" has no in-flight guard, and Promote is neither guarded nor atomic (it reads `promoted_fact_id` and then makes two appends).
findings.proposedFix: Disable both buttons while in flight. Mint `note_id` in the renderer for idempotency. Derive the fact id from the note id, or do both appends in one RPC that checks `promoted_fact_id is null`.

findings.title: The agent's proposed brief (`brief_draft`) is fetched and typed but never rendered, so after an operator edit the agent's version cannot be read: the silent overwrite step 2 forbids.
findings.proposedFix: Render `brief_draft` as a read-only "Agent proposed" block under the brief whenever it differs from the live text.

findings.title: Canvas activity rows show the raw event type (`task.moved@1`) as their text, against the narrative rule SCN-026 enforces for the feed, and they open no receipt.
findings.proposedFix: Reuse the feed's `event.<type>` sentence, keep the type as `title`, and link each row to its receipt.

findings.title: `send()` continues after `flush()` hits a draft conflict.
findings.proposedFix: Have `save()` return its outcome, and abort `send()` on anything but `ok`, leaving the conflict banner up.

findings.title: The estate home passes `onError={() => {}}` to the profile, so a failed `estate.summary()` leaves the panel blank forever, where the scenario requires "unavailable with the reason".
findings.proposedFix: Keep a local failed state in `ProfileSection` that renders the reason and a retry, and pass the real `onError`.

findings.title: `save`, `send`, `checkAgain`, `act` and `refreshInventory` have no try/catch and are called with `void` or from a timer.
findings.proposedFix: Wrap each in try/catch that sets `view='error'` or a send-state refusal while keeping the draft.

findings.title: The figures differ from the scenario: "agents bound" and "releases" are absent, sessions, facts, decisions, grants and events are shown instead, and "work completed" counts `cancelled` tasks.
findings.proposedFix: Add `agent_bindings` and releases counts with register labels and count only `done`, or amend steps 1–2 to the figures that exist.

findings.title: A cancelled drag never clears `dragging` because there is no `onDragEnd`.
findings.proposedFix: Add `onDragEnd={() => setDragging(null)}` and read the task id from `dataTransfer` in `onDrop`.

findings.title: Every agent-filed card is hard-wired to `assigned_to: 'operator'`.
findings.proposedFix: Add an `addressee` input (developer/ceo) to `fabric_task_create` with an ambiguous → `ceo` default, or amend the scenario.

findings.title: The hand-off chain bound fails open.
findings.proposedFix: On error, refuse or downgrade to a proposal, and narrow the read to the session task's ancestry.

findings.title: The stale-claim test compares against `lastActivityAt`, which also moves on operator keystrokes and queued writes.
findings.proposedFix: Add `lastOutputAt`, set only in `pty.onData` (`pty.ts:386-392`), and use it in `claimIsBehind` and `activeAgo`.

findings.title: The stale-account mark is conveyed only by colour and a `title` tooltip (WCAG 1.4.1).
findings.proposedFix: Render visible or visually-hidden text from `agents.claimStale` when stale.

findings.title: `fabric_agents_list` ignores the `agent_stages` read error and reports `claimed: null` ("no claim") when the truth is "unreadable".
findings.proposedFix: Destructure `error` and return `claims_unreadable: <reason>`.

findings.title: `launchOptions()` runs a synchronous `execFileSync('which')` with a 5 s timeout for each of five agents on the main thread, on every `terminal:options` call and again in every `PtyManager.open`.
findings.proposedFix: Use async `execFile` or `fs.access` over PATH, with a short-TTL cache.

findings.title: `terminal:history` interpolates the renderer-supplied `sessionId` unvalidated into a PostgREST `.or()` filter, while `terminal:end` validates it with `UUID`.
findings.proposedFix: Apply `UUID.test(sessionId)` before building the filter.

findings.title: Reopening an ended session's window shows `[session ended]` with no exit code, and the header has none either.
findings.proposedFix: Include `exitCode` in the line and in the header chip.

findings.title: SCN-025 Coverage cites `test/pty.test.mjs`, which only echoes through raw node-pty.
findings.proposedFix: Cite `pty-launch-failure.test.mjs` and `scrollback.test.mjs`, and add an `AgentTile.test.tsx` case for the claim label, age and stale mark.

findings.title: When the default and all other options are unavailable, `choice` falls back to an unavailable default and Launch stays enabled.
findings.proposedFix: Disable Launch when the chosen option is unavailable, and show its reason.

findings.title: Coverage says `Feed.test.tsx` covers step 3 and the raw-type fallback, but the test asserts only `#7` and the Open button.
findings.proposedFix: Add tests that a known type renders its sentence and an unknown type renders the raw type, never `event.<type>`.

findings.title: SCR-24's `current_evidence` in `product-model.json` points at `AttentionPanel.tsx`, which no longer exists.
findings.proposedFix: Repin to `launch/BoardScreen.tsx` and `launch/ObligationActs.tsx`, then regenerate the product report.

findings.title: The legacy `projects.update` and `projects.updateSettings` IPC channels are still exposed, with no base revision and no non-blank name check.
findings.proposedFix: Remove both channels, or route them through `saveProjectSettings`.

findings.title: `replaceDraft` turns the draft tab into a project tab but never deletes `drafts[draftId]`, so every created project's name, purpose and repository paths persist in the drafts file indefinitely.
findings.proposedFix: Delete the draft entry in `replaceDraft`, and add a test.

findings.title: Repository remove buttons are all labelled "Remove".
findings.proposedFix: Use a named `aria-label` with the path, add `aria-expanded`, and use `role="group"` with `aria-labelledby` for servers.

findings.title: A failed `projects.repoStates` read calls the global `onError` on every 10 s poll, so a dismissed banner returns every ten seconds, which the scenario forbids.
findings.proposedFix: Keep a `repoStatesError` shown in the status bar, and raise `onError` only on a none → some transition.

findings.title: FileTree discards why a listing failed, so a boundary refusal reads as "Cannot read this folder".
findings.proposedFix: Keep the error and render `humaniseError(e)`, and add a `.catch` on open.

findings.title: An agent-recorded fact is labelled "an agent reported this" without naming which agent, although `actor_id` is on the row.
findings.proposedFix: Render `runnerLabel` or the created agent's name from `actor_id`.

findings.title: `Tasks.test.tsx` covers only preset offering, not start, history or failure.
findings.proposedFix: Add EditorWindow conflict tests (A2-002/003/004/020), fix the comment, and narrow SCN-032 Coverage to presets.

findings.title: The empty-state copy says each session "is recorded whole when it ends", which contradicts the truncation chip and the recovered partial captures.
findings.proposedFix: Reword, for example: "Each one is captured when it ends; long ones keep their end."

findings.title: The summary maps a missing count header to 0 (`r.count ??
findings.proposedFix: Return `null` when `count` is null (the fix SCN-039 got), and surface a tenure read error as unreadable.

findings.title: Pins and projects load independently.
findings.proposedFix: Gate the `pin-missing` line and the partition on `projects !== null`.

findings.title: `favourites.list`, `toggle`, `move` and `replace` promises have no rejection handler, so an IPC failure is not reported, though the scenario says a failed pin "reports it".
findings.proposedFix: Add `.catch(e => setPinProblem(String(e)))` to each.

findings.title: Task lookups ignore the read error.
findings.proposedFix: Destructure `error` and throw or refuse, naming the read failure.

findings.title: `tasks.detail` interpolates the renderer `taskId` into a PostgREST `.or()` filter, reads the task's journal rows unbounded, and leaves `%`/`_` unescaped in the LIKE prefix.
findings.proposedFix: Validate the UUID, add a limit, and escape LIKE metacharacters.

findings.title: The scenario says notes are "newest first", but the query is ascending.
findings.proposedFix: Order by `created_at desc` (or amend the scenario), make link rows open, and add a "no longer resolves" chip when `target_title` is null.

findings.title: "This is a list because none has been replaced yet" renders even when lineages with replacements are on screen.
findings.proposedFix: Render it only when every lineage has no replacements.

findings.title: Idea-filing failures and transport rejections both show "That move is not available: {reason}", which is the wrong copy for both cases.
findings.proposedFix: Separate the problem kinds (refused, rejected, file-failed), each with its own string.

findings.title: SCN-042 and SCR-32 still say "Coverage: none yet", although `CeoChat.tsx` and `TaskPage.tsx` implement parts with tests.
findings.proposedFix: Update both Coverage lines with the first-slice files and tests, and record the 5-chip cap as a gap or build the picker.

findings.title: Every domain refusal of `answer_question` comes back to the operator as "Persistence could not be confirmed.
findings.proposedFix: Classify the RPC error the way `boardRefusalOf` does: stale revision, settled, no such question, command reused. Return `{committed:false, code}` with fixed codes and render i18n sentences for each. For "settled", fetch and show the existing resolution receipt.

findings.title: `tasks.start` has no command identity.
findings.proposedFix: Generate a `commandId` and task id in the renderer, stable per attempt like `BoardScreen.commandFor`. Pass it as `idempotencyKey` and task id, and make `startTask` look up an existing task or run for that key before appending. Return the refusal as a value with the task id, as `startExisting` does, instead of throwing.

findings.title: None of the panel's calls (`export`, `choose`, `restore`, `check`, `open`) is wrapped in try/catch.
findings.proposedFix: Wrap each call: on throw, move to an `error` view with the retained archive and a retry. In `restore`/`advance`, catch read and parse failures and return `refuse(codeOf(e), …, op.operation_id)`, so the "check again" path becomes reachable.

findings.title: If "Open this Estate" fails, the successful restore result is replaced by "refused: not available for your profile here".
findings.proposedFix: Keep the `restored` view on open failure, show the specific reason with a retry, and expose `history.restored()` as a list of "Restored Estates you can open" in the panel.

findings.title: If `goals.list` fails, the panel builds the plan with zero goals and lists every open task, including tasks that do have a goal, under "Not under any goal".
findings.proposedFix: Track a `goalsFailed` state, render "the goals could not be read" in place of the grouping, and do not compute `planOf` until the goals have answered.

findings.title: A goal whose tasks are all done shows "Nothing is under this goal yet" next to "all N done".
findings.proposedFix: Branch on `progressFor(...).kind`: show `plan.emptyGoal` only for `nothing_planned`, and a "no open work left" line for `complete`.

findings.title: At portfolio level, every project shows "idle" when the board read is unavailable, because `board.data` is null, so `countsByProject` is undefined and `??
findings.proposedFix: Use `refusedBy(board)` / `whole(board)`. When the read is unavailable, show "unknown" on each pill. When `failed` is set, stop showing "reading".

findings.title: With the agent surface down, `servers` is `not_configured`, so `refusedBy` returns the raw string `not_configured` and the panel prints "this could not be read: not_configured".
findings.proposedFix: Branch on the receipt status: for `not_configured`, render `harness.noServer` and hide `harness.strict`. Add a test with `endpoint: null`.

findings.title: The Next-context preview renders counts ("N facts, M transcripts…") and ignores `PackPreview.read`, the envelope that says whether a source failed.
findings.proposedFix: Render `refusedBy(next.read)` or a partial banner naming the failed sources, and label the counts as a floor unless `next.read.availability === 'complete'`.

findings.title: The Back origin is cleared only by pressing Back.
findings.proposedFix: Clear the origin inside `goTo` and in every direct `setActive` from tab or sidebar handlers, or route all of them through `goTo`, which its comment already claims. Add a test: open an entity, click Plan, and assert no Back button.

findings.title: A task hit whose `title` is null (allowed by the type) renders as a blank clickable row.
findings.proposedFix: Select `title,instruction` and use `title ?? instruction` (truncated) as the hit text, as `PlanSection` does.

findings.title: Step 2 says "a group with nothing in it is absent rather than shown as zero", but every store's heading renders even with zero hits.
findings.proposedFix: Skip groups with `hits.length === 0 && !problem` in the list, since the stores searched are already named in the empty line.

findings.title: The panel has no loading state: during the 250 ms debounce and the in-flight read, the previous query's results stay on screen under the new query.
findings.proposedFix: Key results by query text (the `keyedRead` pattern). Show "searching…" while the key does not match, and drop stale groups on error.

findings.title: The copy contradicts the live console: the lede says "The centre shows what one printed; working in it opens its own window", the panel title is "What it printed", and the file header says "THE CENTRE IS NOT A LIVE CONSOLE".
findings.proposedFix: Rewrite `agents.estateLede`/`agents.output` (en and ru) through copywriting to describe the live console, and delete the stale header paragraph.

findings.title: The session list does not show which row is selected: `Row` has no `aria-pressed`/`aria-current` or selected style.
findings.proposedFix: Add a `selected` prop to `Row` (rendering `aria-pressed`), use `t('session.state.*')` and `describeEvent`, and pass `quiet` with the exit code for ended sessions.

findings.title: `TerminalView` resizes the shared PTY whenever it mounts or its host resizes.
findings.proposedFix: Let only one host own the size: for example, the detached window when one is open. Alternatively, have main keep the size of the most recently focused view and ignore resizes from background hosts.

findings.title: The transcript and past-context open has no subject fence.
findings.proposedFix: Capture `sessionId` and apply results only if it is still `openId`, using a ref or the existing `keyedRead` `settled`/`forSubject` pattern.

findings.title: English sentences produced in `shared/` or `main/` are rendered verbatim in the Russian locale.
findings.proposedFix: Return kinds or codes from `shared`/`main` and translate in the renderer, as PlanScreen does with `launch.plan.*`. Add these keys to en and ru.

findings.title: `cursorFor` runs against `highestSeq = 0` while the feed is unread or failed, so any saved cursor is declared "past everything this estate holds, which happens when a generation is restored".
findings.proposedFix: Skip `cursorFor` while `feed === null`. Route the mark-read act through `advanceCursor` with `expectedThroughSeq`, and write `{ readThroughSeq }` only.

findings.title: `drafts.save` claims read-transform-write "so two windows … cannot overwrite each other's file wholesale", but the transform ignores `current` and writes the caller's full set.
findings.proposedFix: Merge per draft id onto `current`, keeping ids the caller did not send unless explicitly deleted, or correct the comment.

findings.title: The plan's history mode renders `Feed` without `onOpen`, so no history row opens its subject (step 5 / SCN-053 step 4).
findings.proposedFix: Pass `onOpen={onTask-capable navigator}` to `Feed`, and add a "Define a goal" action (or a link to `sec-plan`) in the empty state.

findings.title: The empty "Later" and "Resolved" tabs show "A new topic appears here as soon as something needs your answer", which describes the open tab only.
findings.proposedFix: Use tab-specific body keys, or omit the body when `filter !== 'open'`.

findings.title: A failed `runs.status` read is silent.
findings.proposedFix: Keep a `statusFailed` flag and show "status unreadable" beside the chip and the header, matching `RunCallout`'s `statusUnreadable`.

findings.title: The scenario says steps 1, 4 and 5 are NOT built, but `PlanScreen` builds a level navigator that opens tasks and has a plan/history mode.
findings.proposedFix: Decide whether PlanScreen's toggle is accepted, which needs an ADR amendment if so. Then update SCN-046's "Named rather than implied" and Coverage lines, or split history into its own route.
findings.waveWhy: proposed fix needs a decision first ("Decide whether")

findings.title: Coverage lines say "none yet" for built and tested surfaces: SCN-050 (BoardScreen and its tests), SCR-41, SCR-37 (SearchPanel), SCR-45 (RetroSection), SCN-057 (ContextTab, pastContext region `docs:` pointing at SCN-057) and SCN-059 (Star…
findings.proposedFix: Update the Coverage lines with the files and tests, and replace SCR-37's state row with the store-naming behaviour UX28-09 shipped.

findings.title: The two records disagree.
findings.proposedFix: Make SCN-065's Coverage match SCR-48, citing `PrivateHistoryPanel.test.tsx`, and name the unbuilt "open later" alt path (A3-005).

findings.title: The Coverage line lists `HarnessSection.tsx`, the project harness panel (SCR-35), which implements nothing in this scenario.
findings.proposedFix: Remove it and, if helpful, cite `TerminalView` and `runStatus` instead.

findings.title: The scenario record lacks the required `States covered` and `Telemetry` fields, and its Steps field is one arrow-chain sentence with no numbered steps or errors per step.
findings.proposedFix: Fill the template fields (states from SCR-49's table at `docs/ux/screens.md:1056-1063`), or mark the record as a stub outside the scenario gate.

findings.title: The archive's `taken_at` is shown as a raw ISO timestamp.
findings.proposedFix: Format it with the locale, as `BoardScreen` does with `toLocaleString(locale, …)`.

findings.title: Acknowledgement is mount-based, not visibility-based.
findings.proposedFix: Move the band into `ProjectLaunch` above the fold, or record a boundary only after an `IntersectionObserver` reports the band visible. Fix the SCR-31 implementation path in `screens.md`

findings.title: Digest rows are inert.
findings.proposedFix: Pass `onOpen` from `ProjectHome` (`onOpenEntity`) and render `<Row onClick={() => onOpen(line.source)}>`. Add a test that clicks a row

findings.title: `digestMark` ignores the `LocalRead` status and discards the `LocalWrite` result.
findings.proposedFix: Return `{mark, status}` from `markFor` and surface `unreadable` as a digest state. Throw from `setMark` when `status !== 'committed'` so the IPC rejects and the ops log records it

findings.title: The project-change guard is dead: `at` and `project.id` come from the same closure, so `at !== project.id` is always false.
findings.proposedFix: Use a monotonically increasing request-id ref, and ignore responses whose id is not the latest

findings.title: The stale line formats its age without the translator, so Russian shows "3m" inside a Russian sentence
findings.proposedFix: `since(new Date(shown.at).toISOString(), t)`

findings.title: The switch state machine has no cancel.
findings.proposedFix: Add a terminal `cancelled` phase reachable only from `preparing` and `waiting_boundary`, plus `coordinator.cancel(idempotencyKey)`. Have `autoLoop.withdraw` call it. Add a test for cancel-then-new-switch

findings.title: Coverage reads "none yet" although green pure tests exist (`provider-accounts`, `switch-operation`, `auto-switching`).
findings.proposedFix: List the tests and add the same "unreachable: no IPC channel or settings entry" note to SCN-081–085 and SCN-088

findings.title: The "set as default for new conversations" button is labelled with `accounts.system.default`, whose text is "the login the provider already had": a description, not the action
findings.proposedFix: Add `accounts.makeDefault` ("Use for new conversations") in en/ru and use it. Keep `accounts.system.default` for the system-login row

findings.title: "Forget locally" acts in one click, with no review of dependent conversations and no choice of replacement default.
findings.proposedFix: Add a confirm step that lists `boundConversations` and asks for a replacement default. Render `blockedBy` as visible text linked by `aria-describedby`, and test with `userEvent.tab()`

findings.title: A staged login never expires.
findings.proposedFix: Add a TTL (e.g. 10 min). `completeLogin` refuses and deletes expired attempts, and `beginLogin` sweeps them. Add a probe with an injected `now`

findings.title: The auto-switch UI has only an enrol checkbox, labelled with the state word "watching".
findings.proposedFix: Add the scenario's controls as intents. Use a verb label ("Switch automatically"). Format times with `since`/`until` and `t`, map phases through i18n, show account labels

findings.title: Removal blockers and reasons are hard-coded English in shared code and reach the UI, so the Russian locale shows English
findings.proposedFix: Return reason codes plus params, and translate in the renderer

findings.title: `commit`'s hold path discards the result of `persist(held)`, so the caller gets a `needs_reconciliation` operation that may not have been saved.
findings.proposedFix: Check `persist`'s result and return `written.reason` on failure. Prune terminal operations older than N days

findings.title: The diagnostics error banner is never cleared.
findings.proposedFix: On level change: `setView(null); setProblem(null)`. On success: `setProblem(null)`. Render a "reading…" line while `view === null && !problem`

findings.title: A log that cannot be read (I/O error, or sink not yet bootstrapped) comes back as `[]` and is shown as "nothing logged".
findings.proposedFix: Return `{ records, failed: string \| null, lost }` from `diagnostics.read`. Render `failed` as an error state and `lost` as a count

findings.title: The record time is `r.at.slice(11,19)`: UTC hours with no date, which misleads in any non-UTC zone.
findings.proposedFix: Format the time locally with the date. Add `aria-pressed={l===level}`. Add the redacted local export from the scenario (records are already redacted, `shared/opsLog.ts:145`)

findings.title: The project status bar turns a failed quota IPC into `null` and hides the cell, so a failure looks like "no quota/not signed in".
findings.proposedFix: Hold a `QuotaReading` in `ProjectHome`, or lift App's reading via props, and render a muted "quota unreadable: {why}" cell for `failed`

findings.title: Quota ages and reset times are formatted without the translator (`${ageSeconds}s`, `until(...)` with no `t`)
findings.proposedFix: Use `since/until(..., t)`

findings.title: Routine pause/resume is `void setEnabled(...).then(load)` with no catch, so a refused toggle is an unhandled rejection with nothing shown.
findings.proposedFix: Add `.catch(e => onError(String(e)))`. Initialise `rows` to `null` with reading and failed states, and reload on the routine feed mark

findings.title: The next run is shown as a raw UTC ISO string (`2026-10-05T21:36:00.000Z`)
findings.proposedFix: Render `t('routines.next', { time: until(iso, t) })`

findings.title: `tasks.detail` ignores errors on the notes, links, lease, events and sibling reads (`.data ??
findings.proposedFix: Check each `.error`. Return per-section `failed` reasons (siblings `{state:'unavailable', why}`) and render them on TaskPage

findings.title: `tasks.research` returns success when the `spawned` link was refused, and the operator is never told the report cannot be reached from the idea (ops log only).
findings.proposedFix: Return `{ task, linked: boolean, linkProblem }` and show it in the UI. Throw (or return refused) when the note read fails

findings.title: `tasks.prioritise` (attach to goal) and `tasks.note` ignore the task read error and journal with `projectId: undefined` (stored as null).
findings.proposedFix: Read with error check and refuse when the task is missing, as `tasksResearch` does at `main/index.ts:2171-2175`

findings.title: There is no `setWindowOpenHandler` and no `will-navigate` guard in the main process.
findings.proposedFix: In `web-contents-created`: `setWindowOpenHandler(() => ({ action: 'deny' }))` and `on('will-navigate', e => { if (!isRendererOrigin(url)) e.preventDefault() })`. Route allowed URLs through `shell.openExternal` after http/https validation. Add a probe

findings.title: `ProjectHome` keeps dead branches after its early return for `openTask`: `{!openTask && …}` guards and an `openTask ?
findings.proposedFix: Remove the unreachable branches

findings.title: When `goals.list` fails, the plan panel shows no error and no empty state, only a global banner.
findings.proposedFix: Hold `{failed}` state and render `reads.failed` with a retry inside the panel

findings.title: Scenarios are boilerplate ("Черновик сохраняется по объекту; старый снимок не допускает запись" on every one) and claim "Coverage: none yet".
findings.proposedFix: Rewrite each scenario's steps, errors and coverage against the shipped code (PlanSection, QuotaPanel, DiagnosticsSection, Automations, TaskPage), or mark the shipped slice explicitly

findings.title: The agent history renders raw machine ids (event `type` such as `terminal.closed@1`, `actor.kind:id[0..8]`) instead of sentences, against the narrative rule.
findings.proposedFix: Render `describeEvent(t, e.type)` and a translated actor label, as `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/launch/HomeParts.tsx:151` does. Keep the raw id in `title` only.

findings.title: `now` is frozen at mount on Home and Pulse.
findings.proposedFix: Drive `now` from a ticking state (e.g. every 30 s). Clamp negative ages in `liveIsFresh`. Unit-test an event later than `now`.

findings.title: `ProfileSection` is mounted with `onError={() => {}}`, and a failed `estate.summary()` leaves the waiting line on screen forever while the error is discarded.
findings.proposedFix: Keep a local failed state, render it with Retry, and pass the real `onError`.

findings.title: Home shows the chosen avatar and lets the operator set a name and look, while the folded `ProfileSection` on the same page says the portrait and name are "empty on purpose; nobody chose them".
findings.proposedFix: Show the saved persona (`FabricAvatar` + `useFabricName`) with a link to PersonaScreen, and rewrite `profile.portraitEmpty`.

findings.title: Pulse's Live panel reads each running session's status once, keyed on the set of session ids, so a "working" liveness stays on screen with no observation age, and its Pause guards a refresh that never runs.
findings.proposedFix: Poll on `POLL_MS` while not paused (as `EstateAgents.tsx:199-204` does), show `observation.lastOutputAt` as an age, and clear the failed state on success.

findings.title: The favourites calls on Home (`list`, `toggle`, `replace`, `move`) have no rejection handlers, so a refused IPC call becomes an unhandled rejection while the pin looks saved.
findings.proposedFix: Add `.catch` setting a "pin not saved" problem. Test with a rejecting preload.

findings.title: A failed `workspace.state()` read is stored as `{git:'declined'}`, so an outage looks like the operator declining and the workspace question disappears.
findings.proposedFix: Add a separate `unreadable` state with a warn banner, reason and Retry. Never map a read failure onto an answer.

findings.title: The scenario still specifies r0 views, a typed URL source, a login action for auth-required, and one Project with primary and related sources.
findings.proposedFix: Explicitly supersede SCN-095 steps 1–5 by SCN-126/128 (ADR-0100), or file the URL source and the login action as open work rows.

findings.title: The ADR-0081 states ("window closed — the agent is still working" with Reattach; "connection to the agent lost" with input off) are written as behaviour, but no session state carries them, and the `backend_lost` fold is imported only by…
findings.proposedFix: Thread `ExecutionRoot.status` into `TerminalSession` and render `backend_lost` in SessionWindow and AgentTile with input disabled, or mark the paragraph as target.

findings.title: The panel says another person's private history "will not be imported" and leaves Restore enabled, but main then refuses the whole restore as `unavailable`, and a native test pins that refusal.
findings.proposedFix: Choose one behaviour: restore the archive and skip the companion, or disable Restore with a dedicated `not_your_history` code in `ARCHIVE_REASON_CODES` and both locales.

findings.title: A refused import leaves the operation at `stage:'import'`, and `restored()` lists only `done` operations, so the Estate just restored can never be opened.
findings.proposedFix: On a definitive (not lost) import refusal, record `stage:'done'` with `private_history:false` and the reason, include it in `restored()`, and say "restored; private history not imported: <reason>".

findings.title: No panel action catches IPC errors (`handle()` rethrows), and `advance()` re-reads the archive with an uncaught `readFileSync`, so a moved or unmounted archive leaves "Restoring…" on screen forever with no control.
findings.proposedFix: Wrap each action in try/catch that falls back to refused/unavailable. Catch file reads in `advance()`. Copy the archive into the operation directory before the first RPC, so "the file is kept until the result is known" holds.

findings.title: The "unknown" restore lives only in React state, and no IPC lists pending operations, so closing the panel or restarting loses the operation id and the operator cannot look it up with the same operation.
findings.proposedFix: Add `history.pending()` returning the held Person's operations that are not `done`, and render them with Check again.

findings.title: The registry snapshot never reaches the operator (no IPC, preload or screen), so none of the seven registry and MCP scenarios has a surface in 0.3.2.
findings.proposedFix: Add a `registry.read` IPC (entries, problems, readAt) and build SCR-05 (AR-2.4) with RTL tests per state. Until then, the release notes must say the registry is not visible.

findings.title: `JSON.parse` quotes the start of its input in its error message, so about 10 characters of any non-JSON file under `services/` or `providers/` (a symlinked token file, say) reach the problem reason and the ops log, breaking the reader's…
findings.proposedFix: Replace the message with a fixed "the file is not valid JSON" (optionally with the numeric position). Test with a marker file that must not appear in `problems[].reason`.

findings.title: A `--version` that exits non-zero or fails to spawn is reported as a timeout, and its stderr is thrown away, so a fast crash reads as "did not answer" and the error line the scenario requires never exists.
findings.proposedFix: Return a separate `version-failed` result with exit code and one bounded stderr line. Keep `unresponsive` for real timeouts. Test with a fake binary that exits 1.

findings.title: The run outcome (`failed_known`, `outcome_unknown`) reaches the renderer, but no component reads it.
findings.proposedFix: Add `launch.agent.runState.*` and `runOutcome.*` keys in both locales. Render the outcome in `RunCallout` and the rail (with Check again for `outcome_unknown`). Poll while the run is not ended, and show `run.failed` instead of "reading".

findings.title: Every hub hop, refusals included, is journalled as `hub.call.forwarded@1`, and the feed and Pulse describe all of them with one sentence ("an agent's call was passed to a product") and count them in the rhythm chart, so refused, cancelle…
findings.proposedFix: Phrase the event from `payload.outcome` (e.g. `event.hub.call.forwarded@1.refused`), or keep hub spans out of the narrative feed and the rhythm count until AR-6 gives them a trace view.

findings.title: The gateway is "reachable" whenever `~/.config/agentgateway/config.yaml` exists, without a probe.
findings.proposedFix: Probe the origin with a bounded timeout before saying reachable (rename the field `configured` otherwise), or retire the gateway path in favour of ADR-0115's route as AR-3 plans. Update the copy to "configured, not answering".

findings.title: "Revoke" and the danger-toned "Revoke all" act on the first click with no confirmation, although revocation retires the binding for good and SCN-024 specifies "selects Revoke access and confirms".
findings.proposedFix: Add a confirm step naming the agent and what stops (new calls) and what does not (work already sent), with focus returned to the row on cancel. Cover it with an RTL test.

findings.title: The selected agent is not marked in the list, visually or for assistive technology (no selected or `aria-current` support in `Row`).
findings.proposedFix: Add a `selected` prop to `Row` that sets a class and `aria-current="true"`.

findings.title: A failed `runs.status` read renders nothing, so it looks like a bare terminal with no task, and status is never re-read, so a task admitted after selection never appears.
findings.proposedFix: Render a read-failed line, and re-read on the existing poll interval.

findings.title: `terminal:history` puts the renderer-supplied `sessionId` straight into a PostgREST `.or()` filter string without the UUID check `terminal:end` applies (filter injection within the active estate).
findings.proposedFix: Validate with `UUID.test(sessionId)` and refuse before building the filter.

findings.title: The SCR-39 Coverage says "the task the agent holds … none built", but it is built and tested.
findings.proposedFix: Move it to covered and cite the test.

findings.title: `DigestSection`'s project-switch guard is dead code (it compares `project.id` with itself), and the stale-age string calls `since()` without `t`, which prints English "4m" inside a Russian sentence (same at `ProjectHome.tsx:2004`).
findings.proposedFix: Compare against a ref holding the current project id, and pass `t` to `since`.

findings.title: The "schema check timed out" message is unreachable: the catch replaces the timeout error with the generic "could not be verified", and the test asserts only `rejects`.
findings.proposedFix: Rethrow `SchemaReadinessError` unchanged, and assert the message in the test.

findings.title: The product model says the format and SQL are untested drafts and the screen, file writing and IPC are pending, and SCN-097 says "none yet", but the panel, IPC, module and DB/native tests all exist.
findings.proposedFix: Update SCR-65 `current_status` and SCN-097 Coverage to name the tests and the open gaps (A5-011…014, 029).

findings.title: Three of the scenario's fixed reasons ("not this person's history", "not this Estate", "already imported") have no code.
findings.proposedFix: Add `not_your_history`, `wrong_estate` and `already_imported` (SQL plus both locales), or amend the scenario to the codes that exist.

findings.title: The archive folder-picker message is hard-coded English, so a Russian session gets an English system dialog.
findings.proposedFix: Resolve the message from the locale setting, or pass it in from the renderer.

findings.where: SCN-098 "the scan never blocks the screen"
findings.title: `refresh()` runs synchronous `readdirSync`/`statSync`/`readSync` on the Electron main thread every 30 s and on each consent request, with no limit on file count, and the directories can be overridden to a slow mount, the hazard `executor…
findings.proposedFix: Cap entries per directory with a `too-many-entries` problem, and move the reads to `fs/promises` with a bound, or to a worker.

findings.title: Any protocol mismatch, a typo or a future `fabric-service/0.2`, is coded `foreign`, which SCN-100 reserves for "the port answers as another service".
findings.proposedFix: Code a protocol mismatch as `manifest-invalid` (or add `protocol-unsupported` to C5), and align the codes and the comment with C5.

findings.title: A broken symlink, EACCES, or a file removed between readdir and open throws into the JSON catch, so the reason says "cannot be read as JSON: ENOENT…" and names the wrong cause.
findings.proposedFix: Catch filesystem errors inside `readRegularFile` and return "cannot be opened (<errno>)" separately.

findings.title: The detection probe list is a hard-coded id array in the IPC handler, a second copy of `shared/agents.ts`, so a runner added there is never detected.
findings.proposedFix: Derive the probes from `AGENTS.filter((a) => a.program)`, or ship `runners.json` (AR-2.1) and derive both from it.

findings.title: The living SCR-05 entry still describes the old provider catalog (Scenarios: SCN-003, SCN-004).
findings.proposedFix: Point SCR-05's Purpose and Scenarios at SCN-098…104 and SCN-122, and add the `partial` state.

findings.title: Some hub refusals write no span, against the module's own rule ("refusals included", "every hop has its span"): binding revoked, idempotency conflict and idempotency capacity.
findings.proposedFix: Write a `refused` span with the matching `error_code` on each path, and add a test asserting one span per refusal.

findings.title: SCN-109 promises agent-to-agent calls, a Fabric project tool for external agents, and a calls/refusals list in SCR-22.
findings.proposedFix: Amend SCN-109 to name what 0.3.2 ships (products only, via SCN-132/133) and what stays AR-3. Fold SCR-22 into SCR-76 or mark it as the AR-6 trace target.

findings.title: `product-model.json` says the CEO conversation's IPC and screen are pending packets C1–C5 and SCR-22's credential UI is not built, but `CeoChat.tsx` with its IPC is built and RTL-tested (as `screens.md` says), and SCR-76 is built.
findings.proposedFix: Regenerate those `current_status` values from `screens.md`, and add a gate comparing the two registries' status per SCR.

findings.title: If the handler refuses a name at write time (a race past the form's check, or migration 72's lock), the form shows the raw code `agent-name-refused:taken: <name>`.
findings.proposedFix: Use `explainError(e, t)` in `CreatedAgents.create` and put the taken-name problem under the Name field. Add a CreatedAgents test with a rejecting `agents.create`.

findings.title: "Ready" (the scenario's "connected to Fabric's tools") comes from the static descriptor flag `connectsToSurface` for any installed version.
findings.proposedFix: Pin the probed versions per adapter, as `executorAuth` READERS does, and show "installed — connection not verified for vX" outside them. Or reword the scenario's "ready".

findings.title: `launchOptions()` checks each program with synchronous `execFileSync('which')` and a 5 s timeout.
findings.proposedFix: Reuse `executorDetect`'s async, bounded PATH probe, cached per check.

findings.title: No test runs the built helpers from inside `app.asar` under Electron-as-Node.
findings.proposedFix: Before 0.3.2, add a packaged smoke test that spawns both helpers from the built `.app`. The bridge's missing-environment exit code (2) is enough as a check.

findings.title: If `decide()` throws after the operator clicks Allow or Deny (for example, the database is unreachable), the error is only logged.
findings.proposedFix: Wrap `deps.decide` and show `access.prompt.notRecorded` with `sayActRefusal(say,'unavailable')` on a throw. Add a test where decide rejects.

findings.title: The IPC Allow records the decision, then awaits `liveConnection` and `beginConnect` with no guard.
findings.proposedFix: Wrap the post-decide read and connect in try/catch and return `{ok:true, connect:{problem:{code:'live-unreadable'}}}`. Add a test where the post-decide read rejects.

findings.title: When the status cannot be read, the switch is a disabled, unchecked checkbox, which looks the same as "off".
findings.proposedFix: Render the checkbox `indeterminate` (or omit `checked`) when unreadable or loading, or amend the scenario.

findings.title: The scenario says that for an unreadable shared file "the note names why" (does not parse, or its id is not valid).
findings.proposedFix: Carry the reason in `AnalyticsAvailability` (`unavailable-file:invalid`/`:unreadable`) and give each its own note.

findings.title: The note under the switch (what is counted, or why the switch is unavailable) is not tied to the checkbox, so a screen reader announces only the label.
findings.proposedFix: Give the note an id and add `aria-describedby` on the input.

findings.title: A build without the App Key (pnpm dev, smoke, forks) still creates the shared `~/Library/Application Support/PassionCode/installation.json` with `analytics: true`.
findings.proposedFix: When `appKey` is null, read the file without creating it. Assert in the test that `installation.json` is absent.

findings.title: `flush` drops the sent batch with `queue.slice(batch.length)` after an await.
findings.proposedFix: Remove the sent events by identity (a sequence number), or skip the trim while a flush is in flight.

findings.title: SCR-52 Settings is listed as `designed`, "none yet", although the Settings panel is built and carries the analytics switch that SCN-134 cites as coverage.
findings.proposedFix: Update SCR-52's status and coverage, and regenerate the product model (`node scripts/sync-product-ux.mjs`).

findings.title: The native folder picker's message is hard-coded English ("Choose the folder that holds your projects" …) even in a Russian window, though a translator is available in main.
findings.proposedFix: Build the message with `translator(readSettings().locale)` and add the three keys to en and ru.

findings.title: Folders the form made are reported as left on disk only when removed from the list.
findings.proposedFix: Keep `made` in the draft. On Cancel with made folders, say which folders stay on disk.

findings.title: Save is not disabled while a new folder is being made.
findings.proposedFix: Disable Save, and return early from `save()`, while `folderBusy`.

findings.title: The folder rule and the project rule disagree.
findings.proposedFix: Add a `control` folder problem covering `\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f`, with an `onboarding.newFolder.problem.control` key in en and ru.

findings.title: Load and choose errors go to the banner as `String(e)`, so the IPC wrapping ("Error invoking remote method …") reaches the operator.
findings.proposedFix: Use `explainError(e, t)`.

findings.title: After a failed create, the name field stays editable.
findings.proposedFix: Keep the name read-only after a failed create, or have the `already` branch rename (journalled) or say the name was kept.

findings.title: Only Back is disabled during an import.
findings.proposedFix: Keep the import's result in a shell-level store (or the kept scan) and show it on return, or warn before leaving.

findings.title: `reread()` invalidates only its own read.
findings.proposedFix: Use a ref sequence number, as `FirstRun.tsx:127-135` does.

findings.title: A program that answers `--version` without a version shows "Version ?", although `versionFrom`'s contract is that text which is not a version is never shown as one.
findings.proposedFix: Add a "version not reported" key. Log missing binaries at info level under their own op name.

findings.title: A frame over 4 MiB is silently dropped.
findings.proposedFix: Print one dim line naming the dropped frame, and reject the matching pending request.

findings.title: `mayLaunch` accepts any requested mode for a runner with no modes (Codex, Cline, shell), and pty records that mode (for example `bypass`) on the session although no such mode exists.
findings.proposedFix: Refuse a non-null mode for a runner without modes, or record null.

findings.title: The first-run runner list is a hard-coded id array beside `AGENTS`, a second source of truth next to "a runner is one descriptor".
findings.proposedFix: Add a `firstRun: true` flag to the descriptor and filter by it.

findings.title: The sign-in reader's pinned builds duplicate `PINNED_BUILDS`, and the repin script rewrites only the matrix.
findings.proposedFix: Read the versions from `PINNED_BUILDS`, or have the repin script update both.

findings.title: The source fallback inside Electron returns Electron's binary with `--experimental-strip-types` and no `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`, which would open a second app instead of running the helper.
findings.proposedFix: Set `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` when `electron` is true, or refuse the source path under Electron.

findings.title: `oneLine` lets U+061C (Arabic letter mark, a bidi control), U+00AD and U+180E through.
findings.proposedFix: Strip `\p{Cf}` (or add those three) and truncate by code point.

findings.title: The native prompt uses the product's connected state read when the request arrived, not when the operator decides.
findings.proposedFix: Re-read `liveConnection` just before showing the prompt and before connecting.

findings.title: The scenario says "a Fabric window in front", but only the main window counts.
findings.proposedFix: Say "Fabric's main window" in the scenario, or treat any focused Fabric window as in front.

findings.title: When a Disconnect or replacement lands between the callback's live read and the append, the DB predecessor check rejects the append.
findings.proposedFix: Map that check_violation to `connection-changed`.

findings.title: An overflow past 64 KiB caught during the 25 ms poll is swallowed.
findings.proposedFix: Set an `overflow` flag in `drain` and refuse once `run` exits.

findings.title: The refusal code `unavailable` is defined and translated, but nothing produces it.
findings.proposedFix: Catch store errors in the AccessService acts and return `refuse('unavailable', …)`.

findings.title: Each overview reads every live binding's origin request one at a time (N+1 queries), and the open panel polls every 4 s.
findings.proposedFix: Read the origin requests in one `in`-filtered query.

findings.title: "Search covers Russian and English text in full" is false today.
findings.proposedFix: Mark the line as AR-10's target and state the 400k bound. When AR-10 lands, add a Russian/`simple` configuration and a test with an inflected Russian query.

findings.title: SCR-64 contradicts itself.
findings.proposedFix: Set SCR-64 to built with `CeoChat.tsx`/`ceoChatBinding.ts` as coverage, and regenerate the product model.

findings.title: `importConfig` and `exportConfig` have no caller and no test, yet the module header claims byte-equal round-trips and named refusals.
findings.proposedFix: Add round-trip and refusal tests, or remove the importer until AR-5 needs it.

findings.title: SCN-115 enters from "SCR-09 → Trace", but its `screen_refs` name only SCR-09, while SCR-67 lists SCN-115.
findings.proposedFix: Add SCR-67 to SCN-115's refs, and note the SCR-09 dependency (M188/M189) in FLW-65.

findings.title: SCN-122's entry "SCR-05 Agent registry → New agent → From a project" names a control that does not exist.
findings.proposedFix: Add one line to SCN-122 saying that today's "New agent" is SCN-130 and does no conversion.

findings.title: No Electron fuses are set, although `RunAsNode` is now load-bearing (the helpers run as `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`).
findings.proposedFix: Add `electronFuses` to `electron-builder.yml`: `runAsNode: true` (needed, documented why), `enableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable: false`, `enableNodeCliInspectArguments: false`, `enableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation: true`, `onlyLoadAppFromAsar: true`, `grantFileProtocolExtraPrivileges: false`. Have `scripts/release-mac.mjs` read them back (`npx @electron/fuses read`) and fail on a mismatch.

findings.title: "Mark read" writes the renderer's whole settings object back.
findings.proposedFix: Send `{ readThroughSeq: throughSeq }` only. Narrow `settings.write` to a typed patch of the keys a renderer may change (theme, locale, keepAwake, readThroughSeq, firstRun), and refuse `tabs` and `workspace` there. Add a renderer test: change tabs, then mark read, and the tabs survive.

findings.title: The main process's only Supabase client has no request deadline.
findings.proposedFix: Pass `createClient(..., { global: { fetch } })`, where the fetch composes the caller's signal with `AbortSignal.timeout(15_000)` (longer for named long RPCs such as rebuilds). Widen CO-206.

findings.title: `launchOptions()` runs a synchronous `which` per runner (up to 5 s each) on the Electron main thread on every `terminal.options` call and every launch, freezing the UI and the quit timers.
findings.proposedFix: Resolve availability asynchronously (`execFile` with a timeout, or a PATH scan with `fs.access`), cache it per PATH for a short TTL, and look up one runner by id. Record absence as `info` under `pty.runner-absent`.

findings.title: Analytics is **on by default** and sends `app_installed` on the first launch before anything is disclosed.
findings.proposedFix: Show a first-run disclosure with the switch before the first send, or make it opt-in. Relabel it "pseudonymous" and say in the note that one random installation id is shared by PassionCode apps. Have the privacy owner decide whether the cross-app id is needed or per-app ids suffice, and record the decision (ADR) with its legal basis.
findings.status: resolved 2026-10-08 by ADR-0127 (docs/adr/0127-no-usage-count-leaves-before-the-person-has-answered-the-switch.md): on by default, nothing queued or sent before the first-run notice or Settings is answered; shipped in 0.3.3 (carry-over CO-215 and CO-218)

findings.title: The candidate is not described as 0.3.2 anywhere.
findings.proposedFix: wc -l` → 32; `apps/desktop/package.json:3`; `docs/launch/release-mac.md:148-154`, `:191`, `:222`; `apps/desktop/src/shared/schemaContract.json:3-4`

findings.title: The one-shot `grants` table is primary state written outside the journal.
findings.proposedFix: Mint the grant id in the host, carry it with `project_id`/`action_class` in the payload, add `apply_grants` to the dispatcher for issued/consumed/revoked, delete both direct writes, and revoke DML on `grants` from service_role.

findings.title: `issueGrant` drops `projectId` when it writes the row, so a grant the operator gives for one Project is stored estate-wide, and `reserve_effect` lets a NULL `project_id` serve any Project.
findings.proposedFix: Write `project_id` (and `action_class`), or carry them through A7-014's projector. Add a DB test: a grant issued for project P is refused by `reserve_effect` for project Q.

findings.title: `evaluate()` checks the presented grant, but `reserve_effect` reserves the **oldest** matching live grant, and `spendGrant` consumes the presented one.
findings.proposedFix: Pass `p_grant_id` to `reserve_effect` and lock exactly that row, refusing when it is not live. Move consumption into the same SQL function.

findings.title: The board's host schema admits values its SQL parameters cannot take: non-UUID `message`/`thread` ids (`opaqueId`) and an unbounded `idempotency.epoch` cast to `integer`.
findings.proposedFix: Refuse non-UUID ids with the SQL's `not_authorized` sentence and cap `epoch` at 2^31−1 before the RPC. Map SQLSTATE 22P02/22003 to `invalid_arguments`.

findings.title: `board_get`, `board_read_ack` and `board_unread` skip the active-Project check that `board_list`/`board_submit` make, so an archived Project still reads its threads and appends `comms.read_acked@1`.
findings.proposedFix: Add the `board_is_project` refusal to the three functions, with a case in `project-board-db.test.mjs`.

findings.title: The idempotency epoch is the constant 1 and never rotates.
findings.proposedFix: Until COM-02.3, answer `retryable: false` naming the missing rotation. Keep a per-(estate, sender, epoch) counter row.

findings.title: `event_types.projects` is documented as "has a projector branch", yet it is `true` for six types no projector handles (`policy.decided@1`, `grant.*`, `effect.executed@1`, two session types).
findings.proposedFix: Add a migration setting `projects=false` for journal-only types, plus a DB check comparing the flag with the `apply_*` function bodies.

findings.title: `append_event` is re-created whole in nine migrations, each adding an inline guard instead of a function.
findings.proposedFix: Extract per-concern guard functions dispatched from one `append_event`. Accept `source_schema_version between 66 and schema_version()`. Test that `proconfig` contains `lock_timeout=3s`.

findings.title: `rebuild_estate_projections` replays without the estate advisory lock or `lock_timeout`, so an append committing mid-rebuild can be overwritten by older events replayed after it.
findings.proposedFix: Take `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_estate_id::text, 4242))` under `set lock_timeout`, as `append_event` does.

findings.title: `createScopedStore` exposes `insert`/`update`/`delete` with no callers, an API that invites writes around the journal.
findings.proposedFix: Remove the three methods. Default service_role to `select`, and grant DML explicitly on the few primary tables.

findings.title: Migration 81 cites `scripts/check-estate-references`, which does not exist.
findings.proposedFix: Point the comments at what exists (`estate-identity-db.test.mjs`, migration 81). Key `board_requests` by `(estate_id, message_id)`, with no FK to messages (CO-212).

findings.title: `settings.write` lets a renderer set `workspace.path` to any folder.
findings.proposedFix: Accept `workspace` only from `workspaceChoose`/`workspaceImport` (folded into A7-008's narrowed patch).

findings.title: Session-bearer MCP requests are not raced against the client hanging up, unlike the external path.
findings.proposedFix: Apply the same `Promise.race([handleRequest, closed])`.

findings.title: The Keychain read executes `security` by PATH lookup, so a `security` earlier on the session PATH answers instead of `/usr/bin/security`.
findings.proposedFix: Use `/usr/bin/security`.

findings.title: `second-instance` only focuses an existing window.
findings.proposedFix: When `windowReady` and no window exists, call `createWindow()`.

findings.title: The outside quit reaper (`/bin/sh -c "sleep 15; kill -9 <pid>"`) outlives every clean exit by 15 s, kills by bare pid without an identity check, and is absent from the LC-09 footprint table and ADR-0106 §1.
findings.proposedFix: Capture `ps -o lstart=` at spawn and check it before the kill, or kill the reaper from `process.on('exit')`. Add the row to the table.

findings.title: Source, dev and test builds without an App Key still create the shared `installation.json` (`analytics: true`).
findings.proposedFix: Without an App Key, only read the file and never create it.

findings.title: Another app's opt-out reaches queued retries only at the next hourly `refresh()`.
findings.proposedFix: Call `refresh()` (one small read) at the top of `flush()`.

findings.title: 21 `main/` and 15 `shared/` modules are unreachable from any shipped entry (`index.ts`, `acp-shell`, `mcp-bridge`, preload, renderer), among them `ownedBackendProcessRegistry`, `codexLoopback`, `switchCoordinator`, `autoLoop`, `nativeVie…
findings.proposedFix: Add a reachability check to `ci.sh fast` with an allowlist naming the ADR or packet that stages each unwired module.

findings.title: Exports with no caller: `BOARD_TOOLS` (a third board-tool list), `sweepTemp` (temp files from interrupted writes are never swept), `importConfig`/`exportConfig`/`projectNodes`/`DISPATCH_AUTHORITY`, `projectStore` (cited as a guarantee in…
findings.proposedFix: Delete them, or wire them (call `sweepTemp` at startup). Add `knip`/`ts-prune` to `ci.sh fast`.

findings.title: `check-ops.mjs` rule 3 matches only `catch {`, so 21 `.catch(() => {}/undefined/null)` sites escape it.
findings.proposedFix: Extend rule 3 to empty or bare-value `.catch(` arrows without a comment. Set a per-part `error` in `repoState`.

findings.title: A board write that fails in transport (`com.submit`, `com.read_ack`) is answered "nothing was changed", although the RPC may have committed.
findings.proposedFix: For writes, answer "outcome unknown; retry with the same idempotency key". Call `ops.failed` on the `res.error` branch.

findings.title: 13 catches record a synthetic `new Error('… unavailable')` and discard the real error, journal receipt writes included, so a stalled DB, a refusal and a bug look the same.
findings.proposedFix: Record `error.name`/`code` (SQLSTATE, `AbortError`, `ECONNREFUSED`). `opsRecord` already redacts the message.

findings.title: The stdio bridge ignores surface transport errors and closes on one failed `send` without answering the pending JSON-RPC request or logging the HTTP status.
findings.proposedFix: Log the status in `closeBoth`. Answer the pending request with `-32603` and the reason before closing.

findings.title: When one read pushes the ACP framing buffer past 4 MiB, it drops everything, complete frames included, so a dropped response then times out.
findings.proposedFix: Split on newlines first and limit only the trailing partial frame. Use `-32603` for non-method failures.

findings.title: ADR-0117 §2 promises `unsupported_capability` for board tools not yet served.
findings.proposedFix: Register the unserved `com.*` names with a handler returning `refusal('unsupported_capability')`, or amend the ADR.

findings.title: Hand-written tool counts are stale: the docs say 16/11 and 17, the gate measures 27 tools, 19 of which journal.
findings.proposedFix: Replace the numbers with a reference to `surfaceTools.ts`, and widen `SCANNED` to `docs/architecture/*.md`.

findings.title: Both "Next free ID" lines lag their counters: CO-213 while CO-213/214 exist (counter 215), with the CO-212 row placed after CO-214; ADR-0119 while ADR-0119 exists (counter 120).
findings.proposedFix: Update both under the lease. Make `check-registers.mjs` fail when the next id is ≤ an existing row.

findings.title: The `acp-shell` and `helper-process` regions point at ADR-0119 §1.
findings.proposedFix: Add an "Implementation state" line to ADR-0119, or point the regions at the amendment the code implements.

findings.title: Analytics `KNOWN_KINDS` is another hand-kept agent-id list and is already wrong: it has `codex-cli` where the id is `codex`, and lacks `kilo`, `hermes` and `cline`.
findings.proposedFix: Derive the kinds from `AGENTS`, or drop the kinds no event sends.

findings.title: `check-design-map.mjs` hashes untracked files `.gitignore` does not ignore.
findings.proposedFix: Use `node_modules` without the slash, or exclude it in the filter.

findings.title: The accepted private-archive schema versions live in three hand-kept places (TS list, SQL list, `schemaContract.json`), and a test hard-codes 79.
findings.proposedFix: Assert `sourceSchemas.at(-1) === schemaContract.maximum`, and derive the TS union from the const array.

findings.title: SCN-134, the analytics switch shipping in 0.3.2, has no index row.
findings.proposedFix: Add the row in the release change.

findings.title: The release analytics App Key is compiled into the bundle (`define`) in plain text.
findings.proposedFix: State in `docs/ANALYTICS.md` that the key is public, and name the server-side limits (rate, schema, `environment` filter).
